chatgpt_codex.evidence: Executable paths, commands and ancestry identify ChatGPT, two Codex renderers and a Codex GPU service. Renderer bursts approximately correlate with active task updates, but the diagnostic does not prove an individual UI event caused each sample.
chatgpt_codex.required_classification: required_tooling_activity for this agent-driven workflow; potentially avoidable only through a separately validated non-Codex launch workflow

docker_desktop_renderer.evidence: Full command and ancestry lead from Docker Desktop Helper Renderer through Docker Desktop to com.docker.backend. com.docker owns port 6333 and the qdrant/qdrant:v1.16.2 container was running throughout.
docker_desktop_renderer.required_classification: required current service-hosting process tree; renderer-specific avoidability is unknown

historical_git.evidence: The 488e112 artifact retained only basename git and CPU 59.8, without PID, PPID, command, cwd or start time. No git process crossed the threshold in 1200 formal samples, including repository/freeze checks.

historical_browser.evidence: The 488e112 artifact retained browser count one, not a process identity. Formal observation recorded zero Chrome/Safari-rule samples.

operating_system_background.evidence: Commands and launchd ancestry identify Phone, FaceTime store, Siri inference, media analysis, mobile assets, duet, audio, weather, ecosystem and Safari Safe Browsing processes. Exact triggering events were not available.

read_only_preflight_simulation.interpretation: The existing settle removed the simulation process's setup spike, but an unrelated required UI process still violated afterward. Git did not reproduce.

system_correlation.qdrant_host: Docker container qdrant/qdrant:v1.16.2; com.docker listening on 127.0.0.1:6333
system_correlation.spotlight_status_after_observation: enabled; no Spotlight process crossed the threshold during observation
limitations: The historical git and browser processes had already exited and their original snapshots contain no identities or command lines.
Frozen controls and rich process detail are sequential snapshots; counts can differ for sub-second processes.
The active diagnostic conversation itself creates ChatGPT/Codex UI work, so correlation does not isolate every UI trigger.
The service simulation omitted the reranker health probe to honor the no-inference requirement.
Backup and Spotlight status are post-observation snapshots, not continuous traces.

decision_reason: A clean power/browser precondition was insufficient: required current tooling and service-hosting process trees repeatedly crossed the unchanged rule during passive and post-simulation phases. No verified external procedure can remove both while preserving this agent-driven workflow and Docker-hosted Qdrant. Do not change the rule in this investigation and do not authorize another baseline yet.
